content: Counter design (RPS) in strategy games: categorize units into legible groups (infantry/cavalry/artillery; AoE2 spears>cavalry>archers>infantry) so players/spectators learn fast. Best practice is SOFT counters (60-40/70-30) not hard counters, so execution/positioning can overcome a bad matchup. Depth comes from hybrid/multi-attribute units, tiers, terrain, flanking, range/mobility differentials, and timing/power spikes. Our spec already encodes soft counters via weapon break-armor ratios (hammer vs helmet 5, bow vs shield 0.2) and armor reduction formulas rather than binary type tags. Emergence in multi-agent AI battles is a cited source of watchability and research value.
